blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The International Criminal Court (ICC) Trial Chamber III has convened its third status conference on the crimes against humanity charges against former President Rodrigo Duterte. The agenda for Wednesday’s proceedings revolves mostly around the prosecution’s case against Duterte, particularly its list of witnesses, list of evidence, disclosures to the defense, as well as other possible incidents to be added to the case. READ: Prosecution to ICC: Duterte still a flight risk Judges will also decide how much time will be allotted to the prosecution to present its case against Duterte.
